id: title:Gilbert09:add openaq latest flags and yearly tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for OpenAQ location, sensor quality flags, and yearly aggregates, including parent-child joins and flag flattening.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate implementation and metadata definition for OpenAQ warehouse ingestion, including removal of deprecated settings, addition of canonical descriptions, and implementation of parent-location joins and flag flattening. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion. P1.F7.H2 is excluded from scoring as it only tests,;
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunks; no shared dependency or configuration changes are supplied, and the chunk is conservative, so broader systemic impact or shared dependency changes are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative grouping of an OpenAQ warehouse-source change. No other PRs are supplied, so no cross-PR relationship or unrelatedness can be established. No tier assignment is performed; this chunk is not scored.
